newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average jumps more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average jumps more than 100 points.

text.p: Blue chip stocks leaped more than 100 points on Friday as investors shrugged off a government unemployment report that gave conflicting signals about the strength of the labor market last month.

Just after 11:30 a.m. EDT, the Dow Jones industrial average was up 105.01 points, or 1.37 percent, at 7,405.03, a new high. The New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading were previously activated when the index gained more than 50 points. The Nasdaq composite index, laden with high-tech issues, was up 4.06 points at 1,394.11.
